worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.summary: Throw a rigged bouquet: it curves after the target (this attack never misses) and bursts the moment it lands, driving every petal into the weak point (always a critical hit). Wreathe spreads the bloom to nearby foes; the landing leaves pink petals.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.use.0: Take out a target with guaranteed hit and critical
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.use.1: Spread the bloom across a cluster
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.use.2: Leave a patch of petals that fades on its own
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.descriptio: The bouquet deals %1$s Grass physical damage and both never misses and always lands a critical hit.
Throw range %1$s blocks, bouquet speed %2$s blocks/tick, turning up to %3$s degrees per tick toward the target.
The bloom spreads %1$s blocks around the target and leaves about %2$s blocks of pink petals that linger %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.wreathe.on: Wreathe: the bloom rings outward and splashes nearby foes, leaving more petals, at the cost of a little bloom power, bouquet speed and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.wreathe.of: Focused: every petal drives into one target, with more power, faster and cheaper.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.growth.0: From level %1$s the bloom rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.growth.1: From level %1$s the bloom rises to %2$s power and the wreathe splash radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.preference: On (wreathe): the bloom rings outward and splashes nearby foes, leaving more petals, but power x0.85, slower bouquet and +6 ticks cooldown. Off (focused): every petal into one target, power x1.14, faster and cheaper.
